implementationAdvice: Separate original teaching content, official-source alignment and learner achievement. A completed lesson is not an earned certification.
Track objective-level coverage as missing, overview, lesson, practice, lab, assessed; domain links alone are not full coverage.
Use original practice questions with explanations and source-backed rationale, never recalled exam dumps.
Display exam ID, blueprint date, last review and unresolved verification status on every certificate page.
Require genuine sandbox performance for practical credentials; simulated interfaces teach concepts but do not prove operational competence.
Keep all real paid-cloud labs opt-in with budgets, permissions, teardown and no stored secrets. Prefer safe offline exercises by default.
